title: Solo Leveling
source: Solo Leveling web novel by Chugong and webtoon (finished), including the side stories.
world: Gates open across the world, leading to dungeons full of monsters, and awakened Hunters ranked E to S fight them. Sung Jinwoo, the weakest E-rank, nearly dies in a hidden Double Dungeon and becomes the only Player of a mysterious System that lets him level up. He becomes the Shadow Monarch, commanding an army of shadow soldiers, and fights the Monarchs who want to destroy humanity. In the end he resets time and lives a normal life with his family.
power_system: Hunters awaken with fixed ranks, except Jinwoo, who levels up through the System's quests and stats. As Shadow Monarch he raises the dead as loyal shadow soldiers with 'Arise'. Monarchs and Rulers are ancient powers at war.
